entries.measures: Real PubAck, consumer ACK and independently retrieved message hashes across no action, one non-client member restart, or bounded two-member quorum loss with same-ID publication reconciliation.
entries.limits: No client or leader failover, native rotation, installed-manager, security-efficacy or physical disk/power-failure claim.

entries.measures: Two CPU replicas, real process-local session, request observations, exact installed policy/target audit chain and independent effect.
entries.limits: Attributable non-selection is valid; a dispatch acknowledgement is not completed effect or continuous availability.

entries.measures: Cold metrics and an explicit primer completion; the same two-request prefix population in both arms; direct idle reset, miss/repopulation and busy refusal bracketed by eight exact normal-length completions and final idle metrics.
entries.limits: Logical reset only; the post-cohort counter is fixture-local protocol evidence, not a comparative performance result. No physical erasure, poisoning mitigation, cross-tenant isolation or installed selection claim.

entries.measures: Actual engine admission, one late-selected authenticated unfinished SSE anchor captured and aborted by the engine operation, all engine dispositions, explicit unattributed background snapshot IDs, two fresh empty-queue observations and reopen.
entries.limits: Client attribution is limited to the exact anchor; queued requests without an SSE identity remain unattributed and fullCohortAttributed is false. Direct operation-bound backend control; no graceful voice drain, MIG or installed selection claim.

entries.measures: Production NativeActuator route-rotate selector rekey, exact EndpointSlice membership, bounded HTTP identities and protected rollback.
entries.limits: Selector rekey only; no locator, credential, session, security-efficacy, universal-availability or installed-brain claim.
